diagnosis.what_happened: Table numbering was authored as 'جدول ۳۱-۴' (table-chapter) rather than the standard Iranian institutional format 'جدول ۴- ۳۱' (chapter-table).
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Inverting the order of chapter and table numbers violates Iranian graduate thesis guidelines and causes Bidi bidirectional rendering confusion in Microsoft Word.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Table numbers in Persian theses must place the chapter number first followed by hyphen and table number ('جدول [شماره فصل]- [شماره جدول]', e.g. 'جدول ۴- ۳۱').
diagnosis.rationale_why: Standard institutional thesis formatting mandates Chapter-Table hierarchical ordering to facilitate systematic cataloging and list of tables generation.

desired_behavior: Number all thesis tables with chapter first: 'جدول [فصل]- [شماره]' (e.g. 'جدول ۴- ۳۱').
generalization: Universally format all thesis table and figure captions using the 'فصل-شماره' hierarchy across all Iranian academic deliverables.
